m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hmmph. I'm skeptical, a little irritated even, but all right. Wizard, we don't allow tourists here. You will be an Initiate... for now.
You must begin by going to the Repository to study the Arcanum Creed. That will give Baba Yaga and myself time to... catch up.
So you managed to figure out the Creed. I feel surprise, but not disappointment. Perhaps Baba Yaga's assessment was not entirely wrong.
You recall my concerns about Shadow Magic? Well, unsurprisingly, I was right. In fact, it's worse. Started as a trickle but now it's a flood.
We have much to discuss, but first, who is this with you? I'm sure I've told you before. New people make me nervous, especially young ones.
I asked you to go and study the Arcanum Creed. Have you forgotten or given up? I'm feeling... unimpressed.
